watch.readinessNote: One Steam build id covers both platforms (content depot 443032 Linux, 443031 Windows). The native connector hooks only server builds pinned in games/conan-exiles/native/core/pins/pins.json (GNU build-id on Linux, PE TimeDateStamp-SizeOfImage on Windows); on any other build it connects, reports the unknown build and refuses every action until the build is re-pinned (games/conan-exiles/native/tools/repin.py).

native.description: The native connector, loaded into the dedicated server process: libtakaro-conan-native.so through LD_PRELOAD on Linux, a winmm.dll proxy next to ConanSandboxServer-Win64-Shipping.exe on Windows. It holds the Takaro connection itself; no sidecar, no RCON

bridge.description: Deprecated legacy Node.js sidecar (RCON + log files), frozen and shipped for one more release cycle for servers that have not moved to the native connector yet
